composition_subtypes.role: count partitions and max substring length via prefix DP

payload.core_composition_summary: DP counts valid partitions and tracks max segment length; greedy scan finds minimal partitions.
payload.rationale: Two distinct mechanisms: DP for counting/max-length, greedy for min partitions. They operate independently on the same constraints but are sequential computations.
